description: Unit test class for ImmutablePolicyBuilder, testing various policy building scenarios using JUnit and AssertJ assertions.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutablePolicyBuilder, testing policy creation, modification, and validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ImmutablePolicyBuilder instance before each test.

methods.name: createEmptyPolicy
methods.description: Tests creation of an empty policy and checks its ID and namespace.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyId
methods.description: Verifies that setting a null Policy ID throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyIdCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that setting an invalid (null) Policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyEntry
methods.description: Checks that passing null to set method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyEntries
methods.description: Checks that passing null to setAll method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromScratch
methods.description: Builds a policy from scratch specifying labels, subjects, resources, and permissions, then validates the result.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromScratchWithScopedLabel
methods.description: Builds a policy with scoped labels and verifies the correct resource and permissions associations.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromExistingPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new policy based on an existing one, modifies it, and verifies changes.

methods.name: replaceExistingPolicyEntry
methods.description: Replaces or adds a PolicyEntry in an existing policy and verifies the presence and permissions.

methods.name: buildPolicyWithoutPolicyId
methods.description: Builds a policy without specifying an ID and checks that the ID is absent.
